title: England’s zombies have rapidly descended into collective brain fog in Six Nations — The Guardian
text:
Title: England’s zombies have rapidly descended into collective brain fog in Six Nations — The Guardian

Or is it inspiring man-management and an innate understanding of how best to win the biggest games? England are great at analysing footage in retrospect, rather less so at reacting smartly in real time à la Ireland’s scrum-half Jamison Gibson-Park. The excellent Stuart McCloskey, Rob Baloucoune and Caelan Doris would also presently walk into the England team, and significant changes appear inevitable for Italy. But if their main men are either knackered, out of form or past it, an instantaneous revival becomes even trickier. And what’s that coming over the hill? Why, the Springboks in Johannesburg in July. Between now and then England’s “zombies” need to wake up fast.
